newsitem.title: NORWAY: Some oil output reduced at Statfjord, Gullfaks.
newsitem.headline: Some oil output reduced at Statfjord, Gullfaks.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeseskap AS said on Friday it had reduced production at some platforms on the North Sea Statfjord and Gullfaks developments, but it expected to begin offshore loadings soon.

Statoil said throughput at Gullfaks A had been cut to a minimum 1,600 cubic metres per day, around 10,000 barrels per day (bpd), but the B and C installations could continue pumping at full capacity until 1400 GMT.
Output at the Statfjord A platform was also reduced but there was no figure for the level of production, Statoil spokeswoman Nina Steihaug said.
Statfjord C, including oil from the Statfjord North and East satellites, was down to about 39,000 cubic metres per day versus normal levels of around 50,000 cubic metres per day.
Statfjord B would continue to pump at full capacity, at least until 1400 GMT.
Weather conditions improved overnight and Statoil hoped to begin loadings soon, she said.
Five shuttle tankers were waiting in the area, ready to hook up to the offshore loading buoys.
